name: Drift Reel
description: Full-screen WebGL image reel where rows of photos curve along a wave and drift infinitely with scroll velocity, bending as they move.
contents: Fixed full-screen WebGL canvas with three rows of looping images
behavior: Lenis infinite smooth scroll drives the image movement
Images shift and warp by scroll speed through a vertex shader
Rows move at different speeds for depth
editableByProps: Images, direction, row layout, sizes, gaps, curve and speed
Camera distance, background color, smoothing, Lenis options and loader

needsCodeEdit.change: Change image fit or add effects

fixed: Canvas is fixed to the viewport and covers the whole screen
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
